d: Pakistan's proposed plan to create new provinces has triggered a political confrontation within the country's ruling coalition, bringing the future of Sindh and the demand for administrative restructuring into focus. PPP chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari has raised strong objections, while President Asif Ali Zardari has reiterated the party's position during discussions with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. The controversy has also brought Imran Khan's Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) and its demand for a separate South Punjab province into the debate. Watch.
